_doc: Endpoint policies (harness/endpoint_policy.py): the component sets an outcome's pool ADMITS, typed per input with held witnesses, recorded BEFORE an input is added. A pending input needs a recorded decision before the interval of any pool containing it is computed or inspected; a pooled row outside the policy is blocking.

policy.statement: each trial's OWN prespecified major-cardiovascular-event composite is the input; component sets differ between trials and are typed per input from their definition sentences
policy.decided_by: the topic protocol (outcome 'major vascular events', evidence units named in the question)
policy.basis: the rule the two retained inputs were admitted under; recorded here, not changed

pending.label: HOPE-3 (>= 70)
pending.component_basis: RELAYED (Ridker 2017, PMID 28385949, a letter that is not held): no held text to derive it from
pending.mismatch: a 3-POINT outcome: no revascularisation and no unstable-angina hospitalisation, while both retained inputs are broader trial-defined composites
decision_options: adopt a typed-component policy that admits narrower composites, disclosed per input
re-express every input as 3-point MACE where each trial reports it
pending.decision_rule: the decision is recorded (who, when, which option, why) BEFORE the interval of any pool containing HOPE-3 is computed for use or inspected; it is never chosen by whether that interval excludes 1

diagnostic_already_seen.note: a 3-input DIAGNOSTIC was relayed on 2026-09-28, before any policy decision; recorded so the decision's timing relative to it stays auditable -- it is not a served result

witness_of_report.span: Primary Prevention With Statin Therapy in the Elderly: New Meta-Analyses From the Contemporary JUPITER and HOPE-3 Randomized Trials.
